Unlike traditional optimization methods that may get trapped in local optima, this approach uses adaptive momentum and energy-dependent search ranges inspired by quantum annealing. The momentum parameter and step size dynamically adjust based on gradient magnitude, preserving feasible configurations while maintaining global search capability. The algorithm prioritizes shifts with star-shaped contribution patterns and projects gradients to preserve constraints.
